texto: «er is» (there, singular) or «er zijn» (there, plural) is used to detail the rooms: «Er is een woonkamer met veel licht» (there is a living room with a lot of light). «op de... verdieping» is used to indicate height (on the... floor / floor). The expression «dichtbij» means nearby and «betaalbaar» describes an affordable price or rent.

frases.nl: Ik woon in een klein appartement op de tweede verdieping.
frases.es: Vivo en un apartamento pequeño en la segunda planta.
frases.en: I live in a small apartment on the second floor.

frases.nl: Er is een woonkamer met veel licht.
frases.es: Hay un salón con mucha luz.
frases.en: There's a living room with a lot of light.

frases.nl: De slaapkamer is rustig, maar niet groot.
frases.es: El dormitorio es tranquilo, pero no grande.
frases.en: The bedroom is quiet, but not big.

frases.nl: De keuken is naast de woonkamer.
frases.es: La cocina está junto al salón.
frases.en: The kitchen is next to the living room.

frases.nl: De supermarkt is dichtbij en de huur is betaalbaar.
frases.es: El supermercado está cerca y el alquiler es asequible.
frases.en: The supermarket is nearby and the rent is affordable.

bloques.pregunta: On which floor is the apartment described in the text?

opciones.explicacion: «Op de tweede verdieping» indicates the second floor.
The ground floor is called «op de begane grond».
The first floor would be «op de eerste verdieping».

bloques.pregunta: What quality does the living room stand out?
bloques.frase: Er is een woonkamer met veel licht.

opciones.texto: It is a luminous stay with abundant natural light.
opciones.explicacion: «Veel licht» means a lot of light or very bright.

opciones.texto: Which is very noisy about the outside traffic.
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't say it's noisy, it's got a lot of light.

opciones.texto: That he doesn't have windows to the street.
opciones.explicacion: On the contrary, having a lot of light presupposes good orientation.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the word that designates the monthly cost of the house.
bloques.frase: De supermarkt is dichtbij en de ___ is betaalbaar.

opciones.explicacion: «Woning» is the housing itself, not the rental price.

bloques.pregunta: What does the adjective «betaalbaar» mean in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: «betalen» (pay) derivative and expresses that the price is reasonable.

bloques.frase: De keuken is naast de woonkamer.

opciones.explicacion: «Naast de woonkamer» places the kitchen next to the living room.

opciones.texto: On the top floor next to the bathroom.
opciones.explicacion: There's the bathroom upstairs, not the kitchen.

opciones.texto: At the end of the outside garden.
opciones.explicacion: It's an apartment on the floor, not a house with a garden.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the quality of silence and tranquility of the bedroom.
bloques.frase: De slaapkamer is ___, maar niet groot.

opciones.explicacion: «Duur» means expensive, does not fit as quality of stay.

bloques.frase: Er is een woonkamer met veel licht
bloques.traduccion: There's a living room with a lot of light.
bloques.explicacion: existential structure («Er is»), substantive with article and prepositional complement.

intro: It describes the characteristics of a house, its distribution and the surroundings of the neighborhood.
